## Quality assessment and rights

- Both selected garments and both striped pointed-toe shoes are visible in the
  final image. Head, feet and floor margin are preserved; broad pose/background
  remain. The service's AI MODIFIED label remains visible.
- **Not exact product fidelity:** the reference jacket has one front button but
  the result shows two; pocket/texture/folds are reinterpreted. Trouser waistband
  and buttons are partly covered by the jacket. Shoe stripe spacing, colour and
  heel geometry are not guaranteed to match the product exactly.
- Face/hands/fine background pixels are regenerated. Similar appearance is not
  identity/pixel preservation. One synthetic example does not establish real
  photograph quality, repeatability, fit size or measurement accuracy.
- The P50 region-preservation composite was not applied: prior boundary artefacts
  were not resolved, and protected-pixel equality alone would not prove quality.

## External processing and deletion

Official contract: [multi-product](https://genlook.app/docs/tryon-api/multi-product),
[upload](https://genlook.app/docs/tryon-api/endpoints/upload-image),
[create](https://genlook.app/docs/tryon-api/endpoints/create-try-on).
Uploads used `crop=false` and **REST `keepForDays=1`** (SDK `retentionDays=1`);
results used uploaded image IDs and default resolution. Two clothing products
cost 2 credits; clothing plus footwear in the same request is unsupported, hence
separate one-credit shoes request. Upstream model name/version is **not disclosed**;
adapter revision/hash identifies our contract, not vendor model weights.

Each finished stage issued deletion for its owned customer and actual created
products: **5 DELETE responses, all HTTP 204**. This confirms API acknowledgement,
not immediate erasure of every backup/audit record. [DPA](https://genlook.app/dpa)
separately describes generation/security logs (2 years), consent records (5 years),
backup retention (up to 30 days). No deletion request was presented as guaranteed
remote inference cancellation. Existing P50 uploads/results and their evidence
were not overwritten.

## Remaining acceptance conditions

1. Developer/QA: enough host memory for the already prepared focused Android
   compilation/tests; then candidate build, trusted signature/version/hash checks.
   Current P51 Kotlin changes are a local checkpoint, not a validated APK.
2. Operator/client: reviewed authenticated HTTPS service, processing policy and
   separate budget for future real jobs. Keep current depleted trial ledger; do
   not clear it or reuse this authorization. No new charge is authorized here.
3. Client/device QA: version-specific installation approval, then S25+ magic wand
   → actual new request → comparison → save → app restart → reopen, with accessible
   pre/post data checks. Do not load this research PNG as an app-generated job.
4. Quality owner: additional authorized examples and acceptance criteria for face,
   garment details and shoes. Correct button/pattern drift before claiming exact
   product fidelity. No automatic quality guarantee has been implemented.

Preview18605, QA18607, all previous delivery APKs and user data were outside this
